question: Which model architectures do they test their word importance approach on?

extractive_spans: Transformer BIBREF1 model and the conventional RNN-Search model BIBREF0
evidence: We choose the state-of-the-art Transformer BIBREF1 model and the conventional RNN-Search model BIBREF0 as our test bed. We implement the Attribution method based on the Fairseq-py BIBREF19 framework for the above models.
